Name: Buckler
Description: This small metal shield is worn strapped to your forearm. You can use a bow or crossbow without penalty while carrying it. You can also use your shield hand for other purposes (such as holding a second weapon), but you take a -1 penalty on attack rolls while doing so.

Name: Klar
Description: The klar is a wooden shield fitted to a large, skull-shaped spike. When used as a shield, the klar grants a +1 shield bonus to AC. While using the klar as a weapon, you lose the AC bonus.

Name: Shield, Light Steel
Description: You strap a light shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A light shield's weight lets you carry other items in that hand.

Name: Shield, Light Steel Quickdraw
Description: This light steel shield has special quick-release straps that allow you to don or remove it as a free action.

Name: Shield, Light Wooden
Description: You strap a light shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A light shield's weight lets you carry other items in that hand.

Name: Shield, Light Wooden Quickdraw
Description: This light wooden shield has special quick-release straps that allow you to don or remove it as a free action.

Name: Madu (Leather)
Description: A madu is a round, light shield with two animal horns projecting from opposite sides of the shield. If you are proficient with the madu, you may use it to fight defensively with a -2 penalty instead of the normal -4.

Name: Madu (Steel)
Description: A steel madu is a round, light shield with two metal spikes projecting from opposite sides of the shield. If you are proficient with the madu, you may use it to fight defensively with a -2 penalty instead of the normal -4.

Name: Poisoner's Buckler
Description: This buckler has a hidden reservoir that can hold one dose of poison. As a swift action, you can coat a weapon you're holding with the poison.

Name: War-Shield, Dwarven
Description: This shield has blades and spikes mounted on it. It can be used as a weapon while still providing shield bonuses, though it's an exotic weapon for non-dwarves.

Name: Shield, Heavy Steel
Description: You strap a heavy shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A heavy shield is so heavy that you can't use your shield hand for anything else.

Name: Shield, Heavy Wooden
Description: You strap a heavy shield to your forearm and grip it with your hand. A heavy shield is so heavy that you can't use your shield hand for anything else.

Name: Snarlshield, Steel
Description: This heavy shield has chains and hooks that can entangle opponents. Once per round as a free action when you're hit by a melee attack, you can attempt to entangle your attacker's weapon.

Name: Snarlshield, Wooden
Description: This heavy wooden shield has chains and hooks that can entangle opponents. Once per round as a free action when you're hit by a melee attack, you can attempt to entangle your attacker's weapon.

Name: Tower Shield
Description: This massive wooden shield is nearly as tall as you are. In most situations, it provides the indicated shield bonus to your AC. As a standard action, however, you can use a tower shield to grant you total cover until the beginning of your next turn. When using a tower shield in this way, you must choose one edge of your space. Any attack that passes through that edge is treated as if you had total cover. You gain no shield bonus to AC while using a tower shield in this way.
